purpose: Pitch-competition audit trail of human-led, GenAI-assisted PHVS research and valuation
coverage: Selected material exchanges recovered from visible conversation and repository artifacts; not an exhaustive transcript or exact tool chronology.

model_disclosure.family: System identifies assistant as based on GPT-6
model_disclosure.historical_model_changes: Not verified; do not infer a uniform configuration across all work
model_disclosure.agent_use: Earlier user authorization and agent names appear in conversation context; exact historical dispatch details are not reconstructed. Recent erosion and launch-comparison work did not spawn new agents.

process.human_role: Defines investment questions, challenges assumptions, supplies licensed expert calls and sell-side reports, proposes hypotheses and comparative methods, selects scenarios.
process.ai_role: Retrieves and organizes evidence, checks definitions, translates hypotheses into explicit calculations, implements and tests models, records uncertainty and corrections.
constraints: Preserve both long and short arguments
process.validation_caveat: Source verification, independent arithmetic and sensitivity tests have occurred; systematic multi-prompt replication and independent external adoption validation have not been completed.

events.objective: Test whether RAPIDe-3 patient disposition undermines efficacy evidence.
events.user_contribution: Questioned 88 paired participants versus 134 randomized, attack frequency, study closure and prophylaxis use; requested granular evidence rather than accepting headline results.
events.ai_method_and_sources: Organized registry/CTIS participant-flow evidence and distinguished randomized people, treated people, paired people and treated attacks.
events.snapshot: 134 randomized;113 treated201 attacks;88 treated both attacks;25 treated one;21 treated none.35 sponsor-closure cases were part of46 incomplete participants.
events.thesis_effect: Weakened an initial missing-patient short argument; incomplete paired observation cannot automatically be called toxicity or efficacy withdrawal.
events.value_add: Made dispersed denominators and disposition categories comparable, turning suspicion into a testable reconciliation.
events.limitations_and_checks: Aggregate reconciliation does not establish absence of informative missingness or recover patient-level outcomes. Backfill is not a claim of a pre-registered audit.

events.objective: Assess comparative efficacy before translating headline differences into market share.
events.user_contribution: Challenged placebo relief times, requested controlled cross-trial comparisons and a Culper-style endpoint/amendment audit; resisted moving directly into commercialization.
events.prompt_excerpt: Why is median initial relief over double
events.ai_method_and_sources: Compared trial publications, FDA analysis and CTIS protocol evidence; searched for patient/attack-level data and prior analytical rules.
events.snapshot: FDA changed missing-assessment censoring for sebetralstat; placebo median became not estimable versus the published6.72 hours. CHAPTER-3 protocol specified overdispersion and supplementary negative-binomial analysis.
events.thesis_effect: Corrected earlier simplistic placebo-gap interpretation and weakened claims that variability was ignored; superiority and amendment impact remain unresolved.
events.value_add: Detected that superficially comparable headline statistics used different analysis rules and narrowed which concerns remained decision-relevant.
events.limitations_and_checks: No linked patient dataset or complete original/revised SAP comparison recovered. Mechanistic plausibility and cross-trial signals are not proof of superiority.

events.objective: Build credible long and short commercial arguments from expert interviews.
events.user_contribution: Supplied five AlphaSense calls, highlighted same-MOA rescue/prevention concerns and injectable dosing preferences, and explicitly required a strong long steelman despite a prospective short.
events.prompt_excerpt: it's important to have a very strong steelman long as well
events.ai_method_and_sources: Extracted and organized doctor views with transcript references; separated preferences, prescribing anecdotes and hypotheses from measured adoption.
events.snapshot: Competing drivers: oral convenience/control versus incumbent satisfaction, longer-interval injectables, coverage and uncertainty about using the same mechanism for both settings.
events.thesis_effect: Kept a plausible conversion opportunity alongside commercial-friction arguments rather than selecting only bearish quotations.
events.value_add: Reduced transcript volume to conflicting decision drivers that can map to model assumptions.
events.limitations_and_checks: Small selected expert sample; no population weights or causal switching probabilities. Licensed transcripts should not be reproduced wholesale in public pitch materials.

events.objective: Translate the commercial debate into a patient-based IR/XR framework.
events.user_contribution: Proposed separate formulation SOTPs, distinct switching populations, payer weighting, a second-oral comparator and rescue/prophylaxis cannibalization; asked to weigh both sides quantitatively.
events.prompt_excerpt: we just have to do the math
events.ai_method_and_sources: Mapped segments to paid adoption, persistence, prices and rescue dispensing; checked launch reports, patient disclosures, claims studies and analogue limitations.
events.snapshot: Do not multiply Orladeyo's81% paid share by its >1,600 active count: disclosed populations differ. Rescue dispensing also includes initial stock and replenishment, not only attacks consumed.
events.thesis_effect: Prevents overstated addressable revenue and double counting while leaving room for meaningful conversion from existing therapies.
events.value_add: Converted narrative disagreements into observable variables and identified denominator errors before they entered a valuation.
events.limitations_and_checks: National transition rates and joint coverage/persistence remain unmeasured. No complete patient adoption model or Monte Carlo yet.

events.date_basis: Dated model artifacts and commit history; original prompt timestamp not independently recovered
events.objective: Estimate sales requirements conditional on a stock price and stated approval probabilities.
events.user_contribution: Proposed reverse SOTP/DCF using near-price-target sell-side assumptions and provided the reports.
events.prompt_excerpt: take the PoS as a given, and then adjust the revenue ramp
events.ai_method_and_sources: Audited13 PHVS and6 BCRX supplied reports, selected a coherent source ramp, preserved differing broker methods, built formula-linked valuation and independent cash-flow verification.
events.snapshot: Kept twelve distinct PHVS broker targets; identified stale same-day assumptions and inconsistent printed tax arithmetic. Source revenue probability basis remains unconfirmed.
events.thesis_effect: Reframed debate around what sales must be achieved rather than labeling commercial opportunity large or small.
events.value_add: Cross-document consistency checks and executable conditional calculations made assumptions inspectable and easy to challenge.
events.limitations_and_checks: Not recovered consensus or identified buy-side expectations. One price cannot identify two revenue ramps. Independent arithmetic is not external forecast validation.

events.objective: Replace a terminal-value shortcut with explicit post-generic economics.
events.user_contribution: Challenged perpetuity assumptions, requested comparable small-molecule falloff, rejected reliance on three weak analogues and proposed separating P x Q.
events.prompt_excerpt: aggregate many comparable small molecules revenue fall-off together
events.ai_method_and_sources: Audited BioMarin/Lundbeck/Sobi disclosures, discovered pooled generic-entry research and extracted CMS gross spending and dosage units with reproducible arithmetic.
events.snapshot: CMS2020–24 Kuvan: units-88.2%, gross spending/unit-3.9%; Xenazine: units-82.6%, gross spending/unit+44.7%. Orfadin formulations confounded a clean erosion comparison.
events.thesis_effect: Changed the working mechanism from generic-driven price cuts to potentially dominant branded-volume loss; reduced confidence in a Kuvan-only base case.
events.value_add: Connected company revenue disclosures to a different operational data source to distinguish mechanisms hidden by revenue alone.
events.limitations_and_checks: Small Medicare samples, mixed strengths, gross prices before rebates. Never divide global manufacturer revenue by Medicare units to infer net price.

events.objective: Implement the user's50/50 pooled-study and rare-disease erosion scenario with explicit P/Q.
events.user_contribution: Asked why published pooled data could not be used, selected50/50 weighting and reiterated the P/Q requirement.
events.prompt_excerpt: lets just do 50/50, make sure u segment out pxq btw
events.ai_method_and_sources: After failed direct figure retrieval, recovered publisher appendix through browser download; visually checked numerical labels for452 formulation-specific definitions in the same271-compound paper. Added model formulas and scenario checks.
events.snapshot: Blended revenue retention years1–4:47.7/36.2/28.7/21.8%. Effective P:110.4/115.5/118.6/126.9%; Q:43.2/31.4/24.2/17.2%. At dated$31.83 target, peak requirement increased from about$1.585bn to$1.623bn.
events.thesis_effect: Quantified that this erosion change raises required peak revenue modestly under the existing discount rate and timing assumptions.
events.value_add: Made a user-directed hypothesis into an editable and reconciled valuation scenario, with evidence and assumptions separated.
events.limitations_and_checks: Material qualification: study-side product of pooled P and Q is synthetic, not observed mean revenue; it omits covariance and has sample differences. Kuvan P assumed flat; Q implied.50/50 and post-year4 tail are assumptions. Native Excel not tested. Formulas, independent valuation and arithmetic identities checked.

events.objective: Test whether competitive HAE markets warrant a different post-generic price path.
events.user_contribution: Proposed that multiple therapeutic alternatives could prevent price increases and hypothesized increases may be limited to first-in-class/sole therapies.
events.prompt_excerpt: price might not increase after patent expiry
events.ai_method_and_sources: Compared the hypothesis with market-segmentation explanations and primary empirical research controlling for substitution across molecules.
events.snapshot: Competing explanations: payer alternatives constrain net pricing; residual brand customers may be less price-sensitive despite competition. Flat-price case remains a candidate, not established truth.
events.thesis_effect: Challenges direct transfer of pooled price increases into PHVS; motivates pricing sensitivity independently of volume.
events.value_add: Separated a testable HAE hypothesis from an overly universal claim about all drugs and identified what would discriminate the explanations.
events.limitations_and_checks: Old empirical evidence does not validate future HAE pricing. Flat PHVS price override has not been implemented; current blend still implies rising effective P.

events.objective: Expose whether larger IR sales are evidence-driven and benchmark the IR launch requirement.
events.user_contribution: Challenged why IR exceeded XR despite a potentially larger XR dollar TAM, then requested an IR launch comparison.
events.prompt_excerpt: why do you model greater revenue from IR than XR
events.ai_method_and_sources: Traced formulas to Guggenheim source forecasts, disclosed fixed common-scaling limitation, retrieved Ekterly quarterly actuals and expanded the comparison tab.
events.snapshot: The62/38 IR/XR split is inherited, not an independent TAM estimate. Ekterly Q3'25/Q4'25/Q1'26 sales13.7/~35.4/39.2m; PHVS first subsequent full calendar year128.2m versus156.8m annualized Q1 benchmark.
events.thesis_effect: Prevents presenting model-imposed product mix as a market conclusion. Early IR requirement is not obviously extreme, but age-matched and longer-term evidence is incomplete.
events.value_add: User challenge exposed an unvalidated structural assumption; AI traced it and supplied a more transparent benchmark.
events.limitations_and_checks: Q4 derived from rounded totals; annualized quarter is not annual guidance/actual. No multi-year Ekterly actual ramp recovered. Product mix unchanged, not solved independently.

events.objective: Preserve an honest, reviewable account of human-led GenAI diligence for the pitch competition.
events.user_contribution: Provided competition rubric and requested retrospective notes plus ongoing capture of their challenges, novel suggestions and guidance.
events.prompt_excerpt: document exactly how I'm using you to perform my diligence and research
events.ai_method_and_sources: Backfilled selected visible exchanges, checked repository state/artifact names/commits and added repository instructions for future substantive turns.
events.snapshot: Structured process log plus concise pitch notes organized by the five rubric fields; user ideas, AI work, evidence, corrections and open questions separated.
events.thesis_effect: No new investment conclusion; supports auditability and accurate attribution.
events.value_add: Creates traceability between user prompts, research iterations, model changes and slide-ready examples without reconstructing a fictional workflow.
events.limitations_and_checks: No exact historic model version, token savings, complete transcript or systematic prompt-replication record is asserted. Future updates require an active session reading repository instructions.

events.objective: Test whether the reverse DCF requires outperforming both incumbent launch ramps.
events.user_contribution: Proposed a unifying interpretation: at80–90%PoS, PHVS must ramp better than Orladeyo and Ekterly.
events.ai_method_and_sources: Recomputed comparisons from saved verified model results, distinguishing stock snapshot, formulation, early launch and lifetime revenue.
events.snapshot: At90%/90%PoS and31.83dated spot, XR first four full-calendar ratios to Orladeyo are1.397/1.029/1.040/0.940. IR first full-calendar128.2m is below Ekterly Q1annualized156.8m; this is not an age-matched actual-year comparison.
events.thesis_effect: Rejects a blanket claim that the market requires outperforming both launches. Supports a higher first-year XR requirement, with later XR broadly comparable at90%PoS.
events.limitations_and_checks: 80%both would mechanically raise success-case revenues12.5% with other assumptions fixed, not a separately validated PoS estimate. Preset ramp/mix and limited Ekterly history prevent unique market-expectation inference.
